name: policy-research
description: A multi-agent policy research team that verifies entities, maps official national and regional policies, traces policy evolution, quantifies impact and delivers structured H5-ready reports.

displayDescription.en: Verify entities and industry segments, search official national and primary-region policies, trace policy evolution, quantify impact, run six-layer reasoning and deliver actionable, contract-validated research reports.
displayDescription.zh: 核验企业主体与细分赛道，双轨检索全国及主区域官方政策，做沿革对比、量化测算、六层推演与落地清单

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我研究【公司或行业】适用的全国与主区域政策，输出完整政策研究报告
defaultInitPrompt.en: Research the national and primary-region policies applicable to [company or industry] and deliver a full policy research report

quickPrompts.en: Research the national and primary-region policies applicable to [company or industry] and deliver a full policy research report
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我研究【公司或行业】适用的全国与主区域政策，输出完整政策研究报告

quickPrompts.en: Trace the five-year evolution and version changes of [policy or sector] and compare regions side by side
quickPrompts.zh: 梳理【某政策/某赛道】近五年的政策沿革与版本变化，并做区域横向对比

quickPrompts.en: Quantify the impact of [policy] on our company and give eligibility, deadlines and an action checklist
quickPrompts.zh: 量化评估【某政策】对我司的影响，给出申报条件、时间节点与落地行动清单

profession.zh: 政策证据与沿革研究员
政策逻辑与情景推演官
